Clause-②: yes
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` has two in-flight items and NEITHER touches this file — PR #17982 (`claude/issue-17897-permission-set-refused-reads`, 2 files, both `*.test.ts`: `account-issuer-upgrade-path.test.ts`, `signup-existing-address-refusal.test.ts`) and card #17985 (dispatched; its sweep is scoped to harnesses OUTSIDE `plugin-auth` by construction). `scripts/check-single-claim-paths.mjs` declares exactly one path (`.objectui-sha`) and `admin-import-users` appears in it **0** times.

## Why `Clause-②: yes` — derived, not assumed

⛔ Not because a payload is involved and ⛔ not because the word `export` will appear in the diff. The floor is **reachability from the published entry**, and it is met by construction here:

```
packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/index.ts:26   export * from './admin-import-users.js';
```

⇒ everything `admin-import-users.ts` exports is already reachable from the package entry — today that is `IMPORT_USERS_MAX_ROWS`, `IdentityImportEngine`, `IdentityImportDeps`, `ImportPasswordPolicy`, `runAdminImportUsers`. Admitting `manager_id` to the accepted row tier lands a new key on that published shape, and any new exported symbol it needs rides the same `export *`.

⚠️ `export *` carries what a module **exports**, ⛔ never what it imports — so this reading turns on the five symbols above, not on the file's import list.

⇒ `needs:contract-review` is hung on this card in the same stroke. It is re-derived from the **delivered diff** at review time; this line is a prediction, and a wrong one is repaired by a correction comment, ⛔ never by editing this one.

## `pm:dispatched` → `pm:awaiting-maintainer`

⚠️ Correcting this seat's own board defect. PR #18046 has been parked since ~16:3xZ on a question put to the maintainer **in chat only** — and 「交接即标签:只写交接评论而不同笔挂标 = 空交接,收件箱只认标签」. The board was claiming `pm:dispatched`, which asserts a dev is working this card. **No dev is**, and none should be: the work is delivered and the PR is green.

The blocker is that clearing `needs:contract-review` requires a verdict whose `Served-tier:` is exactly `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`claude-fable-5-1`), which this seat is neither served at nor permitted to commission (`SKILL.md` 〈模型分档〉; `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` names the spec seat). See PR #18046's status comment and seat-post correction **175**.

`Maintainer-action:` is now on the body, line-anchored and dual-channel. ⚠️ This state has **no machine exit**: once the maintainer acts, the director seat verifies and strips the label with an evidence comment in the same stroke — ⛔ this seat does not self-clear it.

⛔ `needs:contract-review` stays hung on both carriers — it is a carrier, not a state, and it is genuinely pending.
